$comment: Selectors for the Franpos back office. Copy to config.json (or point FRANPOS_EXPORT_CONFIG at it) and adjust after a `--record` run. Comma-separated selectors are tried in order.

login.usernameSelector: input[name='username'], input[name='email'], input[type='email'], #username, #email, input[placeholder*='user' i], input[placeholder*='email' i]
login.submitSelector: button[type='submit'], input[type='submit'], button:has-text('Log in'), button:has-text('Login'), button:has-text('Sign in')

steps.$comment: Optional clicks/fills/selects before the export, e.g. choosing a location or report type.

report.downloadSelector: a:has-text('Export'), button:has-text('Export'), a:has-text('CSV'), button:has-text('CSV'), a[download], a[href$='.csv']

columnMap.$comment: Optional: rename scraped header text → import column names. Leave empty to keep the page's headers.
